org_ref.name: Park People
org_ref.mission: Park People works to advance city parks as essential spaces to connect people to each other and the rest of nature. They envision a Canada where everyone has access to a vibrant park where people and the rest of nature thrive.
org_ref.description: Park People is the only national, bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks in Canada. It collaborates with community leaders, non-profit park organizations, and park professionals to realize the potential of urban green spaces for connecting people and nature across the country.

job_ref.title: HR & Admin Coordinator
job_ref.summary_ref: This HR & Admin Coordinator role supports the Finance, Admin, and HR teams at TREC and its clients by managing HR logistics, coordinating recruitment, handling office administration, and assisting with financial tasks, ideally within a non-profit context.

gemini-3.6-flash.mission: To support and mobilize people to activate the power of parks to improve quality of life, build community belonging, and enhance ecological integrity in cities across Canada.
gemini-3.6-flash.description: Park People is a national bilingual charity dedicated to championing city parks in Canada. It supports and mobilizes communities, community leaders, and decision-makers to activate parks for social connection, equity, health, and environmental stewardship.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.mission: Park People supports and mobilizes people to help them activate the power of parks to improve quality of life, fostering social connection, equity, and ecological integrity in cities across Canada.
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.description: Park People is a national, bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks in Canada, supporting a network of people and groups to activate the power of parks for vibrant, equitable communities.

groq.mission: Support a Canadian network of park people by sharing knowledge, connections, and funding.
groq.description: Park People is a national and bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks in Canada.
